scene.title: After 15 turns, the agents' JSON quietly falls apart
scene.sceneHtml:
TicketFlow: Week 7

After 15 conversation turns, agents start returning malformed JSON. First few turns: perfect schema compliance. Turn 15: missing fields, wrong types. You identify the failure mode as format drift—context pollution diluting schema attention. Fix: output validation + context pruning.

takeaways: Format drift: output structure decays over many turns as noisy context buries the schema. Fix: validate every output + manage context.
Context rot vs overflow: quality drops even when the window fits. Fix with pruning or summarization, not a bigger window or model.
Temperature controls output randomness, not context capacity or attention; it never fixes format drift or context overflow.
Whole-document keeps cross-section reasoning but citations drift; chunking gives precise citations but loses cross-chunk synthesis.
